instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Implement multi-driver request dispatch with nearest driver priority matching and notifications displaying driver name, photo, and bike/auto/car number.
Display explicit Bike, Auto, and Car price cards in the booking header and fare calculation box consistently.
Include ML-based dynamic fare calculation considering distance, weather, speed, and demand.
Provide mid-ride cancellation with reasons (Weather, Breakdown, etc.) and fair fare recalculation.
Support real-time weather monitoring and ride status tracking.
Provide final payment modal and post-ride rating/feedback (1-5 stars & comments).
